```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(moments)
library(patchwork)
library(Hmisc)
library(here)
```

```{r}
pd <- readRDS(here("data", "ProjectData_2324.rds"))
```


```{r}
# Conduct listwise Deletion
var <- c("Demqol_staff", "visit", "agecat", "marital3cat", "npi_symptoms_0", "chc_04")
pd_select <- pd[var]
pd_clean <- drop_na(pd_select)
```


```{r}
# Dataset version with ordinal/categorical data converted into factors
pd_copy <- pd_clean
pd_copy$chc_04 <- as.factor(pd_clean$chc_04)
pd_copy$marital3cat <- as.factor(pd_clean$marital3cat)
pd_copy$agecat <- as.factor(pd_clean$agecat)
pd_copy$visit <- as.factor(pd_clean$visit)
```

We conducted listwise deletion on missing data. The variable with the most number of missing observations is the outcome variable (NA=471). After removing missing observations from the outcome variable and accounting for all the covariates, a further 27.8% decrease in the sample size is observed, making the reduction in total sample size around 48% (772/1486). Below you can find descriptive statistics on the variables of interest as well as appropriate graphs that show their respective distributions.

It can be seen that skewness is present in the variables quality of life and neuropsychiatric symptoms, with the former having a skewness of -1.14 and the latter a skewness of 0.62. A Q-Q plot further confirms the former (see appendix). The categorical variable marital status also has uneven observations, with 55% of observations being from the widowed category.

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(pd_copy, mapping = aes(x = Demqol_staff)) +
         geom_histogram(aes( y = after_stat(density)),
                             binwidth = 5, color="white") +
          labs(x = "Dementia patients' quality of life") +
          geom_density(color = "lightblue", linewidth = 0.7) +
          theme(panel.background = element_blank())
p2 <- ggplot(pd_copy, mapping = aes(y = visit)) +
          geom_bar(just = 0.5, color="white") +
          labs(x = "count", y = "number of carer visits") +
          scale_y_discrete(
            labels = c("< no visits","≤4.5", "<8.8", "<13.5", "13.5 or more"),
            breaks = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4")
          )+
            theme(panel.background = element_blank())
p3 <- ggplot(pd_copy, mapping = aes(x = npi_symptoms_0)) +
          geom_histogram(aes( y = after_stat(density)),
                             binwidth = 1, color="white") +
          labs(x = "Neuropsychiatric symptoms") +
          geom_density(color = "lightblue", linewidth = 0.7) +
          theme(panel.background = element_blank())
p4 <- ggplot(pd_copy, mapping = aes(y = agecat)) +
         geom_bar(just = 0.5, color="white") +
          labs(x = "count", y = "age categories") +
          scale_y_discrete(
            labels = c("< 75","75-79", "80-84", "85-89", "90+"),
            breaks = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4")
          ) +
            theme(panel.background = element_blank())
p5 <- ggplot(pd_copy, mapping = aes(y = marital3cat)) +
         geom_bar(just = 0.5, color="white") +
          labs(y = "Marital status", x = "count") +
          scale_y_discrete(
            labels = c("married/comm. law","single/sep./div.", "widowed"),
            breaks = c("0", "1", "2")
          ) +
            theme(panel.background = element_blank())
p6 <- ggplot(pd_copy, mapping = aes(x = chc_04)) +
         geom_bar(just = 0.5, color="white") +
          labs(x = "Dementia specialist") +
          scale_x_discrete(
            breaks = c("0", "1"),
            labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
            theme(panel.background = element_blank())
(p1 | p2 | p3) / (p4 | p5 | p6)
```


## Appendix

Appendix A: summary statistics calculations

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide'}
summary(pd_clean)
summary(pd_copy)
sapply(pd_clean[, c("Demqol_staff", "npi_symptoms_0")],
            sd)
skewness(pd_clean$Demqol_staff)
skewness(pd_clean$npi_symptoms_0)
```

Appendix B: Q-Q Plot of the Outcome Variable

```{r}
qqnorm(pd_clean$Demqol_staff, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(pd_clean$Demqol_staff, col = "#3a86d4", lwd = 2)

```

Appendix C: Correlation Tests on Predictors
```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide'}
correlation_test <-rcorr(as.matrix(pd_clean[, -1]), type = "spearman")
correlation_test
```
